blurb: Guests take helicopter tours ranging from 20 to 60 minutes over scenic locations including Camelback Mountain, Phoenix skyline, Sonoran Desert, Sedona, and the Grand Canyon. Flights are narrated live with Bose headsets and panoramic windows. Private and romantic tours are available with personalized itineraries.
extraNote: Flights may be rescheduled at no charge due to unsuitable weather conditions · Phoenix Deer Valley Airport
